observations: A dome-shaped enclosure sits at center, its curved outline drawn in pale blue-white lines against radiating yellow and gold bands that spread from an upper-center bright area.

Inside the dome, a compact dark-blue form with rounded limbs occupies the lower half; above it, a rounder mass carries two large circular shapes filled with yellow swirls, rendered in overlapping loose lines.
Translucent white circles of varying sizes float across the composition—some inside the dome, some outside—softening the ray lines behind them.
reading: A form sits sealed inside a bell-jar dome while gold rays push outward from behind it, so the enclosure reads as both lit from within and pressed upon from without. The floating pale circles sit quietly against that insistent radiance. The loose layered lines inside the dome give the contained form a restless quality that the smooth dome wall holds just barely in check.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #77 shares the same gold-ray burst and a centrally placed dense form, while title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #79 shifts to a dark ground with glowing spiral eyes—placing #78 between warm-field radiance and creature-weight darkness.

connections.reason: Both works use radiating gold-yellow bands as dominant background structure and place a dense central form at the source of that light; #77 fills the frame edge-to-edge while #78 contains its form inside a dome.

The large spiral-filled circular shapes visible inside the dome in #78 reappear as the dominant feature in #79, glowing against a dark ground rather than a bright one—a direct formal echo with reversed tonal weight.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the boundary of the dome meet the radiating lines behind it, and does that edge hold or dissolve?
ambiguities: The form inside the dome carries features that could read as a helmet, a face, or a layered mechanical object; the loose overlapping lines do not resolve to a single reading.
nnxyz nnotb #74 was inspected but shares no strong formal element with #78 beyond the gold palette common across the owned subset, so it was not selected as a connection.
